## 7. AI Workflows & Tactics

- **Date:** 2026-09-14  
  **Source:** [YouTube — How I Use Claude Cowork to Automate 99% Of My Life](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cJ2QCyr3yzU)  
  **Summary:** A high-view workflow describes building a “Cowork OS” around Claude Cowork using local folder structures, persistent project instructions, connectors, and reusable skills.  
  **How to use it:** Create a parent automation folder; split it into project-area folders; add local instructions/personality files per folder; connect services such as Gmail, Notion, Calendar, and Canva; define reusable skills for recurring work such as inbox triage, content research, and task management.  
  **Availability:** Available now where Claude desktop/Cowork features, connectors, skills, and plugins are enabled.  
  **Why it matters:** The practical tactic is durable: constrain agent context with a filesystem-based operating structure before asking it to automate recurring work.
